title: QUIZ - 45
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Solving Equations Requiring Combining Like Terms
questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step equation that requires combining like terms before isolating the variable
questions.question: Solve for n: \( 8n + 1n + -9 = -45 \)
questions.explanation: Combine like terms: (8+1)n + -9 = -45, so 9n = -36. Dividing by 9 gives n = -4.
questions.hint: Combine the like variable terms on the same side first, then isolate the variable.

questions.concept: Solving Multi-Step Equations with Parentheses
questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step linear equation that requires distributing before isolating the variable
questions.question: Solve for y: \( 6(y + 9) + -2 = 58 \)
questions.explanation: Distribute: 6y + 54 + -2 = 58, so 6y = 6. Dividing by 6 gives y = 1.
questions.hint: Distribute first, combine constants, then isolate the variable.

questions.concept: Solving Multi-Step Equations with Parentheses

questions.concept: Multi-Step Equations with Distribution and Combining
questions.learningObjective: Solve an equation requiring both distribution and combining like terms
questions.question: Solve for n: \( 4(n + 6) - 6n + 10 = 26 \)
questions.explanation: Distribute: 4n + 24 - 6n + 10 = 26. Combine like terms: (4-6)n + 34 = 26, so -2n = -8. Dividing by -2 gives n = 4.
questions.hint: Distribute, then combine all like terms on the same side, then isolate the variable.

questions.hint: Distribute, then combine all like terms on the same side, then isolate the variable.
